pages.scan: Image read fresh with the Read tool for this request: works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-08.png. It is a placeholder storyboard. Figures are grey boxes with name tags, there is no drawn art, and the page number '8' is at the bottom. Six panels, read left to right and top to bottom. (1) Top-left panel. Caption box at top left: 'Meanwhile, the pharmacy is notified and fills the prescription.' Teal label box below it with no tail: 'NEW PRESCRIPTION'. Placeholder at upper right is tagged 'pharmacist', with no balloon (silent). (2) Top-right panel. A narrow two-line caption box in the top-right corner: 'The lab is notified.' Directly below it, on the right, a teal label box: 'LAB ORDER: samples to collect'. Placeholder at centre-left is tagged 'labtech' and is silent. (3) Full-width middle panel. Caption at top left: 'Later that day, Ravi gives his samples at the clinic lab.' Placeholder at left-centre is tagged 'ravi' and is silent. Speech balloon at top right, tail pointing down-left to the small 'labtech' placeholder: 'All done, Ravi! We'll let you know when your results are ready.' (4) Tall bottom-left panel. Three-line caption at top: 'Results ready: Ravi is notified.' Teal label box below it: 'Welbuk Health app · email · WhatsApp'. 'ravi' placeholder lower down, silent. (5) Upper of the two stacked bottom-right panels. Caption at top left: 'Dr. Ananya is notified on Welbuk Care.' Teal label box below it: 'RESULTS READY'. 'ananya' placeholder at right, silent. (6) Lower stacked bottom-right panel. Caption at left: 'The clinic is notified on Welbuk Practice.' 'meera' placeholder at centre-right, silent. Teal label box at far right: 'RESULTS READY'.
pages.observation: 1) The order is mostly clear: the 2+1 rows read naturally left to right. In the bottom tier, the tall left panel (4) comes before the stacked right panels (5, then 6). Some readers may hesitate between 4 and 5. The three notification panels seem to be simultaneous, but no caption says so. 2) Text fit in this version: the captions in panel 2 ('The lab is notified.') and panel 4 ('Results ready: Ravi is notified.') now wrap inside their boxes, and their periods no longer touch the box borders. In panel 2, the caption box is pressed into the panel's top-right corner, and its top edge appears to merge with the panel frame. The 'LAB ORDER' label sits directly under that caption with almost no gap between them, and its right edge is close to the panel border. This is cramped but readable. In panel 1, 'fills' still runs to the right edge of the caption box. In panel 3 the balloon still shows 'We' ll' with a visible gap after the apostrophe, which looks like a font or kerning problem. 3) There is only one speech balloon (labtech, panel 3), and its tail points correctly to the labtech placeholder. All other figures are silent. Ravi gives no reply or reaction to 'All done, Ravi!', and no reaction to his notification in panel 4. With placeholder art no reaction can be seen. 4) The teal label boxes have no tails and nothing marks what shows them: a screen, a sign or a phone. A reader cannot tell whether 'NEW PRESCRIPTION', 'LAB ORDER: samples to collect', the two 'RESULTS READY' labels and 'Welbuk Health app · email · WhatsApp' are on-screen text or captions. 'RESULTS READY' appears twice with the same wording (panels 5 and 6). In panel 6 the label sits right beside the 'meera' name tag at the panel's right edge. 5) Continuity: the page opens with 'Meanwhile', which depends on the previous page. Nobody on this page is shown writing the prescription or ordering the lab work. The jump from sample collection ('Later that day') to 'Results ready' has no caption showing how much time passed. Nothing follows up on the pharmacy prescription. 6) Five captions in a row use the same 'X is notified' wording, so the page reads as a list of notifications rather than a scene. All text was readable and no file was unreadable.
